name: managed-provider-docker
goal: Prove explicit Linux Docker and native macOS routing through the shared provider runner, preserving argv, stdio, exits and cleanup with synthetic commands on MB2.

evidence: Tracker 3a82q9: explicit Linux routes to a local offline 2 CPU/6 GiB Docker image; explicit macOS routes to the native Darwin process; legacy tasks remain native. Test argv, stdin, stdout/stderr, exit status, abort and cleanup with synthetic commands through worker and orchestrator.

The shared task process selects Docker for explicit Linux, validates macOS for native runs, and uses one task-owned attached container per generation. Native provider request admission and checkpoint logic continue on the host.

Test-only checkpoint 21652c59d5 reproduced four missing-platform failures on MB2 with one Vitest worker. The same four cases passed after implementation. Full module-tasks E2E passed 13/13, including exact exit 37, byte-for-byte prompt and argv fixture output, cancellation, and removal of its running container. Docker argv policy and routing passed 2/2.
